fact: Space in Africa states NIPOST switched on the National Digital Alphanumeric Postcode on 1 October 2026, giving each captured addressable building an 11-character code.
Nairametrics reports the National Digital Alphanumeric Postcode System launched through NIPOST on 1 October 2026, with users already finding 11-character building postcodes.
TheCable states the federal executive council approved the national digital addressing policy and digital postcode system in March 2026.
TheCable states NIPOST launched the national digital alphanumeric postcode system, assigning 11-character codes to addressable buildings, and its reporters used the application.
